description_en: Creates a live stream with a creation status of not yet started
description_zh: 创建状态为未开播的新直播
kebab_example: aliyun imp create-live --app-id 7m000q --room-id AE35-0000-T95F --user-id as0000hs --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateLive

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the application. The value can contain lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 应用唯一标识，可以包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the room. The value is up to 36 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 房间唯一标识，最大长度36个字符
parameters.name: room_id

parameters.help_en: The user who creates the live stream. The value must be unique within the specified AppId. The value can contain lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and periods (.) and is up to 32 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 创建直播用户，在AppId下单独唯一。小写英文、数字、下划线（_）和小数点（.）组成，最大长度32个字符
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the live stream resource. If you leave this parameter empty, the system automatically generates a 36-character random UUID string
parameters.help_zh: 直播资源的唯一标识ID，传空值时，系统自动生成36位随机UUID字符串
parameters.name: live_id

parameters.help_en: The title of the live stream. The value can contain Chinese and English characters and is up to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 直播标题，支持中英文，最大长度256个字符
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en: The introduction of the live stream. The value can contain Chinese and English characters and is up to 2048 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 直播简介，支持中英文，最大长度2048个字符
parameters.name: introduction

parameters.help_en: The anchor ID. The value can contain Chinese and English characters and is up to 128 characters in length. If you leave this parameter empty, the anchor is the user who creates the live stream
parameters.help_zh: 主播ID，支持中英文，最大长度128个字符。传空值时，主播为当前创建直播用户
parameters.name: anchor_id

parameters.help_en:
The bitrate of the live stream. Default value: 3. Valid values:
-1: smooth (lld).
1: standard definition (lsd).
2: high definition (lhd).
3: ultra-high definition (lud)
parameters.help_zh:
直播推流码率，缺省时默认为3。取值：
-1：流畅lld。
1：标清lsd。
2：高清lhd。
3：超清lud
parameters.name: code_level

Result.description_en: The result of creating the live stream

LiveId.description_en: The unique identifier of the live stream
